paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Probing accuracy with reduced training data.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the probing accuracy of different models as a function of training data size. The x-axis is labeled "Train size," uses a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 2000, and has tick labels at intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "accuracy," uses a linear scale, ranges from 80 to 95, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. A blue line, rendered as a solid line with 'x' markers, begins at an accuracy of approximately 84.2 at x = 0 and increases to approximately 92.3 at x = 2000. A gray line, displayed as a dashed line with 'x' markers, starts at approximately 82.3 at x = 0 and increases to approximately 90.3 at x = 2000. A red line, also shown as a dashed line with 'x' markers, begins at roughly 86.1 at x = 0, then rises to approximately 92.3 at x = 2000.
